definitions.explanation: A person whose job is to sell products, typically in a retail store. A neutral, professional term for someone working in sales.

examples.japanese: {販売員|はんばいいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧みよう。
⟦デパート→デパート：01022_depaato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{販売員|はんばいいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I work as a salesperson at a department store.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧な{販売員|はんばいいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{特徴|とくちょう}→特徴：03456_tokuchou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{説明|せつめい}して→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: A friendly salesperson carefully explained the features of the product.

notes:
{販売員|はんばいいん} is a professional term for a salesperson, commonly seen in job listings and business contexts.

FORMS:
⟦{販売|はんばい}→販売：03573_hanbai⟧ (selling, sales) + {員|いん} (member, staff).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {販売員|はんばいいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a salesperson
- {販売員|はんばいいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{募集|ぼしゅう}→募集：03035_boshuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to recruit sales staff
- {販売員|はんばいいん}⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧: salesperson training

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧: shop clerk (everyday, general term for store staff)
- {販売員|はんばいいん}: salesperson (more professional, used in job listings)
- ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}マン→営業マン：08749_eigyouman⟧ / ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}→営業：01878_eigyou⟧⟦{担当|たんとう}→担当：02567_tantou⟧: sales representative (business-to-business)
- {売|う}り{子|こ}: vendor, hawker (casual, often for street or event sales)
